summary: Backend regression and live preview checks completed. Admin authentication, invite creation, player registration with valid random spaceport coordinates, seeded player login, and core state APIs passed. Admin dashboard visibly exposes Neue Runde and Konfiguration controls.
action_items: Consider adding stable data-testid attributes to admin navigation tabs; exact-text automation is affected by emoji-prefixed labels.
Confirm frontend environment naming: frontend/.env currently exposes REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL, while the project test contract specifies EXPO_BACKEND_URL.
critical_code_review_comments: No Allianz/alliance references were found under backend or frontend/src.
New-round endpoint correctly validates bounds before destructive reset; destructive success path was not executed to preserve seeded test data.
spaceport assignment uses an atomic owner_id:null update with random selection and race fallback.
seed_data_creation: Created invite codes and one temporary RandPlayer test account through the live API; no game reset performed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Player login reached /game with success toast. Admin login reached /admin and dashboard showed Neue Runde and Konfiguration. Tab clicks were not completed by exact-text selector because rendered labels include emoji prefixes; screenshot confirms both controls are present.
rca_of_issue: The two failed tab automation attempts were selector-only findings: get_by_text(..., exact=True) cannot match labels rendered as emoji plus text. This is a testability issue, not confirmed product navigation failure.
